item.title: Table records, coins, Online now and Community
item.description: Five new pages in the Rent Party docs, for table records, Online now and matches, reputation and streaks, coins and the community feed, plus the 2-minute offline rule for live games.
item.content:encoded:
Five new pages cover what’s new in Rent Party: table records, Online now and matches, reputation and streaks, coins, and the community feed.

  • Table records: keep a real-board game’s deeds, bucks and box between nights, share it with friends, and bring it online.
  • Online now and matches: see who’s around, hide yourself, challenge a friend or find a match at a similar level.
  • Reputation and streaks: what your score counts, the 10 levels, “New”, and the daily streak badges.
  • Coins: coin packs on the website, coin tables, coin challenges and sending coins. Coins are in-app only, with no cash value.
  • Community: posts, who sees them, likes, comments, reporting and blocking.

Online play now explains the 2-minute offline rule for live games.

item.title: The Rent Party docs are here
item.description: The rules, online play, your account, plans and help for Rent Party, in one place, with search on every page.
item.content:encoded:
The rules, online play, your account, plans and help for Rent Party now live in one place, with search on every page.

The words come from the game itself: the rules match its How to play page, and Help and FAQ matches its Help page. Here they’re split by topic, so you can jump straight to the rule you need.

New here? Start with Getting started. Rather learn by playing? Practice against a CPU character.
